fusions.name: Muted Phrase
fusions.desc: Spits a knotted thread that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance per hit to leave it [Muddled] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Marginal Gloss
fusions.desc: Annotates an enemy up to 6 tiles away, dealing 9 damage, up to 1.2 times as much at full reach. It needs an affliction of yours on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Redlined Draft
fusions.desc: Strikes out 1 condition on you and on every ally.

fusions.name: Rehearsed Verse
fusions.desc: Whenever you spend mana, your next spell deals 15% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
